title: Held QCLI-502 follow-ups: raw SIGKILL spawn sites, a type-vs-null guard, a dead stdin parameter, and AC4 local-suite caveat
description:
HELD -- the four non-blocking findings from the QCLI-502 review (PR opum-ai/quest-cli#619, merged to dev 3120a709). Do NOT start until team-lead says so.

(1) The SIGKILL-victim spawns at test/qcli122-fourth-pass.test.ts:114, :674 and :725 are left RAW -- they call Bun.spawnSync directly rather than through runCommand, and nothing marks that as deliberate, so a later reader cannot tell an on-purpose raw spawn from one that slipped past the migration.
(2) test/helpers/spawn.ts:53 guards `child.exitCode === null` instead of checking the TYPE -- tighten it so a non-number exit code cannot slip through.
(3) A dead `stdin?: string` parameter at test/cli-task-edit-batch.test.ts:31 and test/qcli122-third-pass.test.ts:51: it selects "ignore" vs "pipe" but the string is never passed to the child, so the parameter is vestigial.
(4) AC4 wording: the literal claim "the full suite is green" is unmet LOCALLY (1207 pass / 1 fail, the local-only QCLI-411 check that requires the pinned bun 1.4.2). Note it so the criterion is read as green-on-the-pinned-runtime.
